BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to defibrillators in schools; adding a new sectionto chapter 28A.320 RCW; making an appropriation; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.320RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each school district's board of directors shall adopt policies forproviding a defibrillator on each campus and for training appropriatepersonnel in the proper use of the defibrillators.

The sum of . . . . dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the biennium endingJune 30, 2005, from the general fund to the office of thesuperintendent of public instruction for the purposes of this act.
